data.title: Establishment and Operation of a 24x7 Security Operations Centre (SOC) and Managed Detection & Response Services for Three Years
data.issuer: Government of Pakistan, Ministry of Information Technology & Telecommunication
data.summary: The Ministry of Information Technology & Telecommunication is seeking proposals to establish and operate a centralized 24x7 Security Operations Centre (SOC) providing continuous monitoring, threat detection, and incident response across its data centres and connected federal entities. The selected bidder will deploy SIEM/SOAR capabilities, staff a tiered L1/L2/L3 analyst team, and deliver managed detection and response services for three years (extendable on performance), including threat intelligence, threat hunting, incident response runbooks, vulnerability assessments, and knowledge transfer.

criteria.name: Relevant SOC / cybersecurity experience and references
criteria.description: Relevant SOC / cybersecurity experience and references.

qa_items.question: Company profile and relevant SOC experience
Understanding of the assignment and proposed technical solution
Threat intelligence and incident response methodology

data.submission_instructions: Proposals shall be submitted in two separate sealed envelopes marked "Technical Proposal" and "Financial Proposal", one original and two copies each, addressed to the Section Officer (Procurement), Ministry of IT & Telecommunication, Islamabad.
